title: Clearer errors from the text API
summary:
Text API errors are clearer, media usage has finer-grained durations, and Polly is less likely to turn a table—or a dollar amount—into a formatting problem.

A team fix maps text-provider rate limits to HTTP 502 instead of passing the provider’s 429 to chat API callers. The response still records `upstreamStatus: 429` for debugging; a 429 from a user-supplied image URL remains client-facing.

A team fix lets generation events record fractional video durations and adds `input_audio_seconds`, `output_audio_seconds`, and `output_video_seconds` to per-request usage responses, CSV exports, and SDK types. Agent-maintained API docs now show the fields. The migration reset historical integer video-duration values in the old column to zero.

Two team fixes make Polly’s tables and equations more reliable in Discord. Table images render bold and italic text instead of Markdown markers, failed image renders fall back to code blocks, and plain dollar amounts no longer get mistaken for math. Replies also keep adjacent text and code together when they fit.

highlights.title: Media seconds in usage history
highlights.text: Per-request usage responses now include `input_audio_seconds`, `output_audio_seconds`, and `output_video_seconds`, so you can inspect audio and video usage alongside each request. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
